# S.S Aqua Feeds & Needs (Siva Sai Aqua), Bhimavaram

Aqua feed, medicines, minerals, probiotics and aerators for shrimp and fish
farmers. Opposite Siva Ranjini Hospital, JP Road (Bazar), Bhimavaram, West
Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh 534202, India. Established 1997. Same
counter, same road, 29 years. Cash, UPI and Paytm accepted. Opens 8:30 AM,
Monday to Saturday. The shop's phone and WhatsApp numbers, closing time,
GPS coordinates and exact brand list are still being confirmed, so this
document states only what the shop has confirmed.

## What the shop is

S.S Aqua Feeds & Needs is a small aqua trading shop on JP Road in Bhimavaram,
at the heart of the West Godavari aqua belt. Farmers call the same shelf by
the second name Siva Sai Aqua; which name should lead is still being
confirmed. For 29 years it has supplied shrimp and fish farmers within about
an hour's ride of Bhimavaram with feed, pond medicines, minerals, probiotics,
aerators and spare parts.

The approach at the counter is plain and practical: no prices printed here
because feed and chemical prices move with the market through a season, so
they are quoted fresh at the counter. No invented claims. If a fact has not
been confirmed by the shop, the site and this document say so rather than
guess.

## The five shelves (/products)

1. Feed (/products/feed). Shrimp and fish feed in the brands and sizes the
   crop needs, matched by stage. Feed is the biggest line in every crop's
   budget, so it is the shelf the shop takes most seriously. Exact brands in
   stock are still being listed.

2. Medicines (/products/medicines). Water medicines and treatments for when
   a pond goes wrong. Usage guidance comes with the sale, on the pack.

3. Minerals and water conditioners (/products/minerals). For hard water and
   long crops. Application rates are worked through with the farmer.

4. Probiotics and pond culture (/products/probiotics). For gut, water and
   pond floor. Routed to the right product by the problem described.

5. Aerators and spares (/products/aerators). Aerators, paddle wheels, spare
   parts and fittings, the fittings that fail mid-crop and the spares the
   shop keeps so a farmer is not waiting on a part.

## Practical questions (/faq)

- How long has the shop been open? Since 1997, on the same road, in the same
  trade. That is 29 years, and the address has never moved.
- What payments? Cash, UPI, Paytm.
- Can prices be given over the phone? Feed and chemical prices move with the
  market through the season; the counter quotes them fresh.
- Does the shop deliver? Delivery and the service area are being confirmed.

## Visiting (/visit)

Address: S.S Aqua Feeds & Needs, opposite Siva Ranjini Hospital, JP Road,
Bazar, Bhimavaram, West Godavari, Andhra Pradesh 534202. Opens 8:30 AM,
Monday to Saturday. Closing time and weekly off are still to be confirmed.
A map embed and directions link are on the visit page.

## Languages

Every page exists in English and in Telugu. The Telugu mirror lives under
/te/ (for example https://www.ssaquafeedsandneeds.example/te/products/feed).
